name: 12_receive_tray
title: Receiving Tray and Organizing Utensils
summary: The robot receives a tray, conceals a cup behind a container, checks the side counter, and returns to uncover the food.
robot: two robot arms with black parallel grippers
setting: a white dining or lab table with another robot across from it

source.original_prompt: Receive the rectangular tray with both arms

segments.instruction: Both arms reach forward toward the edges of the tray held by the opposite robot. The camera stays fixed on the tray.
Both grippers grasp the sides of the tray and pull it down onto the foreground table. The camera tilts slightly downward to follow.
The right gripper picks up the tall drink cup and places it behind the white utensil holder. The camera remains on the table.
segments.memory_event: hide: tall drink cup hidden behind the white utensil holder

segments.instruction: The camera pans left toward the empty counter space as both arms retract slightly.
segments.memory_event: hide: main table and tray turn out of view to the left

segments.instruction: The left gripper rests near the left counter edge while the camera remains pointed at the empty counter.
The camera pans back to the center table. Both arms return to ready position.
segments.memory_event: return: center table reappears with the tray, square food box, pastry stick, and utensil holder as left

segments.instruction: The right gripper reaches behind the utensil holder and returns what was placed there back onto the tray. The camera watches the action.
segments.memory_event: return: tall drink cup retrieved from behind utensil holder and placed onto tray

segments.instruction: The left gripper grasps the lid of the square food container and lifts it up. The camera stays centered on the tray.
